summary: West Fraser filed a Form 6-K containing a news release and report detailing voting results from its Annual General and Special Meeting held on April 22, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine items including election of directors, appointment of auditor, advisory say-on-pay resolution, and reconfirmation of a shareholder rights plan. All director nominees were elected with varying support percentages. The filing is a standard periodic report on routine corporate governance matters, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed.
